title: TimeBridge: Better Diffusion Prior Design with Bridge Models for Time Series Generation

problem.claim: Time series generation requires synthesis methods suitable for data with temporal order and fixed time points.

gap.claim: The fixed standard-Gaussian diffusion prior may be ill-suited to time series data.

contributions.claim: TimeBridge uses diffusion bridges to learn paths between a chosen prior and the data distribution for flexible time series synthesis.
The framework explores prior designs tailored to time series synthesis, including data- and time-dependent priors for unconditional generation and scale-preserving priors for conditional generation.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments show that the framework with data-driven priors outperforms standard diffusion models on time series generation.

narrative_sequence.summary: Time series generation is used for simulation, data augmentation, and hypothesis testing.
Diffusion models have become a de facto approach for diverse time series synthesis scenarios.
The standard-Gaussian diffusion prior may not fit temporal order and fixed time points.
TimeBridge uses diffusion bridges and explores priors tailored to unconditional and conditional time series generation.
The authors report that data-driven priors outperform standard diffusion models.
